name: structured/set-cookie-response
description: Response only: Set-Cookie value and Domain attribute are mapped, attributes survive, keep_cookies keeps a named cookie's value, a sensitive header by substring is replaced whole.

steps.input:
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://portal.corp.io/home?session=abc
Set-Cookie: sid=abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12; Path=/; Domain=.corp.io; HttpOnly
Set-Cookie: lang=en; Path=/
X-Request-Token: tok-123
Content-Type: text/html
Content-Length: 0

expect.equals:
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://portal.target1.example/home?session=[SESSION_1]
Set-Cookie: sid=[COOKIE_1]; Path=/; Domain=.target1.example; HttpOnly
Set-Cookie: lang=en; Path=/
X-Request-Token: [X_REQUEST_TOKEN_1]
Content-Type: text/html
Content-Length: 0
